description:
intent=i017 snapshot=s01 branch=free-invalidates-pointer status=complete
finding location=net/bluetooth/6lowpan.c:522-544 confidence=low conclusion=bt_xmit() frees the skb (dev_kfree_skb, net/bluetooth/6lowpan.c:538) while send_pkt() saved that skb pointer into long-lived l2cap channel state (chan->data = skb, line 438), leaving a dangling stored pointer; no in-tree reader found, so the UAF is latent.
coverage_gap=drivers/net/ was only sampled (hits from the '= skb->data' and queue/handoff-then-use greps over USB, PPP, wwan and wireless drivers); the ~2900 kfree_skb sites there were not all individually audited.
coverage_gap=Free/use pairs separated by more than the 6-12 line heuristic window, or where the free happens inside a helper (netif_rx backlog drop, icmpv6_send, dev_queue_xmit completion, driver TX completion), were not exhaustively traced.
coverage_gap=skb pointers stored inside driver/firmware private structs (e.g. ps->tx_skb in drivers/net/dsa/mv88e6xxx/hwtstamp.c) were only spot-checked, not lifetime-traced to their freeing path.
coverage_gap=pskb_may_pull/pskb_expand_head head-reallocation stale-pointer sites were deliberately excluded per branch instructions (other branches cover them).
limitation=The single finding is a stored dangling pointer with no demonstrated dereference site: chan->data is written at net/bluetooth/6lowpan.c:438 but never read for IPSP channels in this snapshot, so no crash or disclosure is proven; it is reported as a hypothesis with low confidence.
limitation=No build, KASAN or reproducer run was performed (read-only source snapshot, work confined to grep/reading), so all conclusions rest on static reading of this snapshot's exact lines.
limitation=Snapshot revision is opaque (hidden); line numbers and code state are valid only for snapshots/s01 as supplied.
